test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the Indian Air Force's Wing Commander who was captured and later released by Pakistani forces in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinandan Varthaman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinandan Varthaman **is **an Indian Air Force fighter pilot**.
 
• He was **involved **in **chasing **away **Pakistani jets **that **entered India **on **27 February 2019**.
 
• His **plane **was **shot down inside Pakistan **and he was **held captive **there **for 60 hours **after an **aerial dogfight**.
 
• He was awarded Vir Chakra by the **Indian government **for the **alleged downing **of a **PAF F-16 **with his **MiG-21 Bison**, though his claim has been rejected by Pakistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Abhinandan **was **born **on **June 21**, **1983**, in **Tamil Nadu, India**.
 
• His **father **is **a retired Indian Air Force **(IAF) **Air Marshal **(OF-8) and **his mother **is **a doctor**.
 
• **Abhinandan **received many awards**: Vir Chakra, Wound Medal, General Service Medal, Samanya Seva Medal, Special Service Medal, Siachen Glacier Medal, Sainya Seva Medal, high Altitude Service Medal, 9 years Long Service Medal.**
